checks.evidence: apps/web/app/layout.tsx:23 renders all required elements around children. mock-banner.tsx:12 supplies status semantics and mock colours; globals.css:30 defines red. site-footer.tsx:9 matches the authorized 'Bundle version: <v> · Schema <v>' wording recorded in scripts/ralph/batches/t7-shell/prd.json:179.

checks.criterion: AC3: Seven plain next/link destinations in the required order, without prohibited destinations.
checks.evidence: apps/web/components/site-header.tsx:8 imports next/link; lines 11–18 define exactly the seven required destinations, rendered in array order at line 26.

checks.criterion: AC4: Keyboard-operable navigation, visible focus ring and active-route aria-current.
checks.evidence: By reading: apps/web/components/site-header.tsx:26 renders ordinary links without tab-order overrides and sets aria-current through pathname equality. globals.css:67 supplies a 2px focus-visible outline. tests/site-layout.test.tsx:121 exercises each active destination and line 140 checks native link structure.

checks.evidence: apps/web/components/mode-banner.tsx:10 matches PRD.md:168–170, including Mode C's incomplete-radar statement. apps/web/app/page.tsx:13 contains only the title and factual bundle line; the three T0 texts remain supplied by layout components.

checks.evidence: Source uses loadBundle in apps/web/app/layout.tsx:24 and dynamic='error' in app/page.tsx:8. Static build output and a passing smoke run require execution, prohibited by this read-only review.

checks.criterion: AC7: Test-first main-only equality preserves exact banner/footer checks and the production mock guard.
checks.evidence: Main equality is scoped correctly at apps/web/scripts/page-check.ts:256. However, bannerParts at line 197 overlooks a non-live banner wrapper containing two paragraphs, and footers.some at line 253 accepts conflicting footer versions. Both weaken the previous whole-body protection. The production mock guard is unchanged.

checks.evidence: Source inspection finds only apps/web/components/site-header.tsx:1 declaring 'use client'; it imports no bundle or provider. Notes record 177,190 B versus 173,974 B, but these figures and all prior gzip rebuttals remain independently unverified because build and measurement execution were prohibited.

findings.claim: Preserve complete banner-container validation when a non-live red wrapper contains multiple paragraphs. AC7 remains incomplete.
findings.evidence:
By inspection, replace MOCK_P in tests/page-check.test.ts with '

Mock bundle — placeholder data, not results

Radar match passed

'. The wrapper has two text-bearing children, so soleTextChild stops the container walk at the first p. That p records only its own status region, and its text is exact; the unchanged mode, main and footer checks also accept the fixture. The red banner visibly contains an additional claim. Existing tests cover this bg-mock wrapper with a sibling span, but second-paragraph cases give the outer wrapper live-region semantics. Preserve the banner container's identity and add this regression.

findings.claim: Reject conflicting footer versions instead of accepting any one correct footer. AC7's protected-value validation is still weakened.
findings.evidence: By inspection, REAL_PAGE.replace('</footer>', '</footer><footer>Bundle version: v10 · Schema 1.0.0</footer>') is accepted for bundle v1: footers.some succeeds on the original footer, while main equality and banner checks ignore the contradictory footer. T0-05's whole-body equality rejected this additional protected text. Validate an unambiguous footer/version and add a negative case containing both correct and incorrect footer versions.
